entries.description: CSS: centered card login, dashboard card styling, header gradient/logo centering, icon colors, settings text overflow fix, users-page row action menu 44px entries on phones (body:has(table.user-list) .action-item__popper, Deck #504), Impersonate settings select2 border via --color-border-maxcontrast (#impersonate, Deck #504), dark shell (body bg + header icons follow enforce_theme=dark). Login, every mode (light and dark, enforced or system): the 'Senha' label and 'Lembre-se de mim' text are #6b6b6b (WCAG AA: 4.72:1 on the #f1f1f1 input, 5.33:1 on the #fff card).
entries.notes: CSS selectors target upstream DOM classes. If Nextcloud changes class names or HTML structure in v33, these may silently break without merge conflicts. The login contrast rules (every mode) key on label[for="password"] and #rememberme ~ .checkbox-content (the login form's NcPasswordField id and NcCheckboxRadioSwitch input id). Dark shell in header.css keys on body[data-theme-dark] and core vars --color-background-dark, --color-main-text, --color-background-plain-text. Under dark, header.css resets --color-background-plain-text and --background-image-invert-if-bright on #header and #app-dashboard (theming derives them from the bright admin background), so the greeting and 'Mais aplicativos' trigger are light; every app menu icon (themes/avuz and app-shipped black currentColor SVGs, active entry included) gets --background-invert-if-dark in the header and its overflow popover. Dashboard panels and app containers in theme.css use --color-main-background (white in light, dark surface in dark). The header.css dark rules skip guest pages (body:not(#body-login)); login.css pins core light tokens on body#body-login under dark so the login (password eye, help button) stays light.

entries.description: Warns users before navigating away from an in-flight upload. Nextcloud top-bar app switches are full page navigations (not SPA routes), so leaving Files mid-upload tears down the queue and orphans chunks under uploads/{user}/{transferId}/. Two additive layers: (1) a global beforeunload listener in apps/files/src/init.ts that calls event.preventDefault() when getUploader().queue contains any upload in INITIALIZED/UPLOADING/ASSEMBLING — browser shows its own generic confirm dialog; (2) a passive NcNoteCard banner in FilesList.vue (computed hasActiveUploads) shown above DragAndDropNotice while uploads are active.
entries.notes: Both patches are guarded by clear 'AVUZ:' comments. Banner copy is in English so future l10n can pick it up; both extraction points use the existing t('files', ...) helper. beforeunload custom messages have been ignored by browsers since 2016 — the listener only triggers the native confirm. Boot-time sentinel: docker/entrypoint.sh::verify_avuz_patches() greps 'Upload in progress — do not close this tab' in /var/www/html/dist/files-main.js and fails fast if missing (catches a build that didn't pick up the source change). Real fix for surviving navigation would be a Service Worker upload (e.g. tus-js-client + SW), deferred until upload-loss complaints justify the lift.

entries.description: Restores apps/files_downloadlimit/templates/admin.php (a tiny mount-div the upstream JS bundle binds to). The 2.0.0 release tarball published to the Nextcloud App Store ships without this file — packaging bug tracked at https://github.com/nextcloud/files_downloadlimit/issues/421 (OPEN since Nov 2024, no movement). Symptom: GET /settings/admin/sharing → 500 TemplateNotFoundException 'template:admin', whole sharing settings page dies. Without the overlay our boot loop wipes the working template on every restart because entrypoint flips appstoreenabled=true and runs 'occ app:update --all', which re-fetches the broken tarball and overwrites apps/files_downloadlimit/.
entries.notes: Overlay applied at build time via Dockerfile (RUN cp -R docker/overlays/files_downloadlimit/. /var/www/html/apps/files_downloadlimit/) and re-applied at runtime by entrypoint.sh::reapply_avuz_files_downloadlimit_overlay() after every 'occ app:update --all' (same pattern as spreed). Sentinel 'admin-download-limit' in templates/admin.php; entrypoint verify_avuz_patches() fails boot if missing. Drop the overlay once GH issue 421 ships in an upstream release.

entries.description: Spreed overlay (full-file replacements applied at Docker build time) that adds POST /store-chunked/{init,put,finalize} endpoints and the 'recording-chunked-v1' capability so Talk recordings >100MB survive Cloudflare's 100MB body cap. Reuses the existing Talk-Recording HMAC signature scheme (random + checksum headers). Finalize accepts an actualSize from the bot (bytes actually streamed, not the stale init-time totalSize) to avoid races with ffmpeg still flushing, then hands the reassembled file to RecordingService::store() so AI summary + chat attachment flows are untouched. Chunk storage uses raw filesystem under data/avuz-recording-chunks/{token}/{uploadId}/ (not IAppData — NC's IAppData treats slashed folder names literally and breaks getDirectoryListing on nested paths).
entries.notes: Overlay applied at build time via Dockerfile (RUN cp -R docker/overlays/spreed/. /var/www/html/apps/spreed/) and re-applied at runtime by entrypoint.sh::reapply_avuz_spreed_overlay() after every 'occ app:update --all' / 'occ upgrade' (which would otherwise re-download upstream spreed from the app store and wipe our patches). Sentinel 'AVUZ-CHUNKED-UPLOAD-V1' in RecordingController.php; entrypoint verify_avuz_patches() fails boot if missing. Entrypoint also toggles appstoreenabled=true around the configuration block (so app:install/update can reach the store) then sets appstoreenabled=false at the end (admins cannot reinstall spreed via UI). PHP per-chunk limits raised to 64M via /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/avuz-upload.ini; same file also sets memory_limit from PHP_MEMORY_LIMIT env (default 3072M, overriding upstream 512M) so heavy occ jobs (FilesMetadata, scans) don't trip the 300MB cron warning. Requires matching 10.50.100.103:8080/admin/talk-recording bot image. Rebase guide: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-05-21-talk-recording-chunked-upload.md.

entries.description: Fork of nextcloud/nextcloud-talk-recording maintained in github.com/avuz-conecta/talk-recording (private). Pinned to upstream v0.2.1. BackendNotifier.uploadRecording branches on the spreed 'recording-chunked-v1' capability and, for files >CHUNK_SIZE (50MB), uploads via the new POST /store-chunked/{init,put,finalize} endpoints; falls back to upstream single-multipart POST otherwise. Sends actualSize at finalize so the server compares against bytes actually streamed (not the init-time os.path.getsize, which may be stale if ffmpeg is still flushing). Chunk POSTs include explicit Content-Type: application/octet-stream so PHP does not drain php://input trying to url-decode raw bytes. Image published as 10.50.100.103:8080/admin/talk-recording (built linux/amd64), referenced from portainer-recording-stack.yml; replaces nextcloud/aio-talk-recording.
entries.notes: Source + Dockerfile + scripts/build.sh + avuz-entrypoint.sh live in github.com/avuz-conecta/talk-recording. avuz-entrypoint.sh renders /etc/nextcloud-talk-recording/server.conf from env vars at container start (NC_DOMAINS comma-separated for multiple NC backends sharing one bot, RECORDING_SECRET, INTERNAL_SECRET, HPB_*, SKIP_VERIFY, ALLOW_ALL; also accepts the legacy NC_DOMAIN single-host fallback). Upstream pin tracked in that repo's AVUZ_FORK.md. Rebase against newer upstream = pull next upstream tag in avuz-conecta/talk-recording, re-apply chunked-upload + entrypoint commits, rebuild, redeploy.

entries.description: Card 471: 'Confirm new password' field on personal password change, admin set-password (dialog, since user rows are a fixed-height virtual list) and lost-password/first-access reset. Submit is blocked while the values differ ('Passwords do not match.'). Server rejects a mismatch only when the optional newpasswordconfirmation (settings) / passwordConfirmation (lostpassword) param is sent; other API clients are unaffected.
entries.notes: The 2 pt_BR strings live in the upstream l10n files, not the theme: JSResourceLocator stops at the first l10n file found, so themes/avuz JS overrides never load for bundled apps. Upgrades overwrite these l10n files; re-add 'Confirm new password' and 'Passwords do not match.' and rebuild dist (frontend-legacy) after rebase.

entries.description: Card 455: CalDAV plugin stamps X-AVUZ-CREATED-BY;CN=<display name>:<uid> on every VEVENT/VTODO/VJOURNAL when a calendar object is created by a user who is not the calendar owner (share or delegation). Set on create only; on update the stored stamp is carried over and any client-sent value is replaced, so it can't be dropped or forged. Owner-created objects are never touched (no ETag change). Shown by the calendar overlay (calendar-popover-event-color).
entries.notes: New class must stay in the dav authoritative classmap (autoload_classmap.php + autoload_static.php). Listens to Sabre 'calendarObjectChange' at priority 110 (after scheduling). Re-add the two addPlugin lines if Server.php / appinfo/v1/caldav.php conflict on upgrade.

entries.description: 429 page (core/templates/429.php): 'Muitas tentativas' / 'Aguarde alguns minutos e tente de novo.' / 'Voltar para o login', same card. Rendered by RateLimitingMiddleware (guest) and TooManyRequestsResponse (brute-force max delay: login, lost password, public share auth), which now renders as guest instead of a bare unstyled fragment; status stays 429. Both pass pageTitle 'Too many attempts' so the guest layout titles the tab 'Muitas tentativas – <theme name>'. Guest notice card (title, one sentence, next step) for the invalid/expired password-reset link: resetform() renders lostpassword/invalid-link instead of the generic error page (invalid, expired, unknown token, user without email). 'Pedir novo link' goes to login?direct=1#lostpassword (or the custom lost_password_link), which avuz_theme's login-lost-password.js turns into the 'Esqueceu a senha?' view; 'Voltar para o login' goes to the login page. lost_password_link=disabled still shows the generic error page. Status stays 200 + throttle.
entries.notes: core/css/guest-notice.css is plain CSS (no .scss), loaded by the template via Util::addStyle. pt_BR strings live in core/l10n/pt_BR.json (PHP reads core l10n from core/l10n + themes/avuz/core/l10n, not themes/avuz/apps/core); 'Back to login' is changed to 'Voltar para o login' there and in pt_BR.js. Upgrades overwrite these l10n files: re-add the strings. login-lost-password.js depends on the login Vue app's #lost-password button id.

entries.description: Deck #504: upstream impersonate app (an admin logs in as a user to debug), vendored unmodified at apps/impersonate from impersonate-v4.0.0.tar.gz (nextcloud-releases/impersonate, sha256 8008ad02e36c44fd446ed3bb55ac866cbfb6225128150b289ab3de8141036ea8; nextcloud min/max-version 33). Every boot, avuz_impersonate_sync writes app config 'authorized' from AVUZ_IMPERSONATE_GROUPS (comma-separated, default admin) and enables the app once per instance. AVUZ_IMPERSONATE_ENABLED=0 disables it per stack. Layout fixes for its users-menu entry and settings select2 live in apps/avuz_theme/css/settings.css, so the vendored app stays unmodified.
entries.notes: Not in ENABLE_APPS: lib-impersonate.sh owns enable/disable so the env toggle works both ways. Admin-disabled app (installed_version set, enabled=no, no env-off marker) is never re-enabled; marker data/.avuz_impersonate_env_off records an env-driven disable. Never writes [] (the app treats an empty list as 'no group restriction'). Dockerfile ARG AVUZ_IMPERSONATE_VERSION fails the build on a missing or different version. Upgrade: server 34 needs impersonate v5.0.0 (min/max 34) — re-vendor the release tarball, verify its sha256, bump the ARG. Not stamp-gated, so no AVUZ_CONFIG_VERSION bump.

entries.description: Deck #417: 34 Lucide icons (light + -dark pairs, Lucide 0.555.0, generated from apps/avuz_theme/js/lucide.js) seeded at every boot into the External sites icon store (appdata external/icons via IAppData, local disk or S3). Each pair is offered once per instance (avuz_theme/external_icons_seeded): never overwrites an existing file, never re-adds an icon the admin deleted. Opt out per stack with AVUZ_SEED_EXTERNAL_ICONS=0. The admin Icons section points to https://lucide.dev/icons through a pt_BR override of 'Uploading an icon with the same name will replace the current icon.' (plain text: the template escapes it with p()).
entries.notes: No External sites code is patched. Relies on External sites listing appdata icons/ (SitesManager::getAvailableIcons) and serving <name>-dark.svg to clients (IconController::showIcon). Re-check both and the overridden source string on External sites upgrades. To change the set: edit ICONS in scripts/generate-external-icons.py, run it with python3 -I, commit the SVGs.
